desc: 植物萃取保湿贴膜，翡翠展台视觉，人体工学贴合到信任收口
leaf: 植物萃取保湿贴片面膜
name: 植物萃取水润贴片面膜款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清面膜贴与精华袋套装，干净合规赢得点击
用翡翠绿展台与金色点缀一秒立住植物萃取保湿的核心卖点
以抽象肌质分屏放大洁后干燥紧绷的困扰并引出面膜的舒缓时刻
代入清晨梳妆台的真实护理时刻让买家自我投射
以膜布纤维与浸液质感微距证明材质细腻服帖
用平面裁片与开孔裁片的同框对比直观讲清人体工学贴合设计
以留白参数行的结构化信息版式消除疑虑且不虚构任何规格
以翡翠绿金礼遇氛围与空白按钮位收口促单

style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and comparison, soft mint #E8F5EE for info and texture panels, deep jade green #2F9B82 for stage and closing shots
style.direction: fresh botanical skincare commerce with a 3D jade-stage presentation
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and small circular badges, single accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows; subtle skimming side light reserved for texture shots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh botanical skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, soft mint #E8F5EE, deep jade green #2F9B82 and champagne-gold accent #D9B36A; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements in a glossy jade-stage language; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no model faces anywhere in the set
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle; the sheet mask and its sachet always shown together as one set; consistent product scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E7E2DC and glossy jade-green stage pedestal #2F9B82 with champagne-gold trim #D9B36A
